title: PlainSightIL Firestore Database Schemas
description: Ground-truth database schema definitions for Cloud Firestore collections, enabling autonomous AI agents to construct correct models and queries.

geoPoint.description: Firestore GeoPoint object representing geographic coordinates.

localizedString.description: Bilingual string containing both Hebrew and English variants.

cellular_antennas.description: List of active cellular transmission antennas and radiation measurements.

id.description: Unique identifier of the antenna (matches doc ID).

antennaId.description: Operator site or antenna identification code.

geohash.description: Length 9 geohash calculated from coordinates for spatial range queries.

operatorName.description: Translated English name of the cellular operator.

lastTestDate.description: ISO timestamp of the last periodic radiation safety test.

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of last document modification.

cellular_permit_applications.description: Permit applications for cellular towers under construction or review. Follows the blue-green partition system (e.g. permit_apps_blue and permit_apps_green).

id.description: Document unique identifier (often stringified reference number).

permitType.description: Hebrew name of permit stage (e.g., 'היתר הקמה', 'היתר הפעלה').

locality.description: Name of the locality/city in Hebrew.

addressDescription.description: Detailed description of location (e.g. roof, ground-based, street address).

focalPointType.description: Physical structure type (e.g. 'גג' for roof, 'קרקעי' for ground).

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp when the scraper updated this record.

dataset_metadata.description: Coordination meta-records for active scraper sync partitions (Double Buffering metadata).

id.description: Document ID mapping to the dataset name (e.g. 'cellular_permit_applications').

activeCollection.description: The name of the partition currently active for client queries (e.g., 'permit_apps_blue').

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the last complete successful ingestion.

recordCount.description: Total number of documents written to the active partition.

status.description: The operational state of the backend sync cron job.

datasets_metadata.description: Registry of public datasets available or requested for integration in the Directory screen.

id.description: Unique identifier (often matches data.gov.il resource/package ID).

publisher.description: Government ministry or agency publishing the dataset.

resourceCount.description: Number of resource files in the government package.

isSupported.description: True if fully integrated and visualized in the app. False if in the roadmap (voteable).

dataset_requests.description: Tracks community voting metrics for roadmap dataset activation requests.

datasetId.description: Target dataset ID (matches doc ID in datasets_metadata).

datasetTitle.description: Hebrew title of the requested dataset.

requestCount.description: Total aggregation count of votes cast.

lastRequestedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent vote.

votes.description: Identifies users who voted to prevent duplicate voting (one vote per anonymous uid). Doc ID = user UID.

votedAt.description: Server timestamp representing when the user clicked request.
